name: Font of Life
primary:
A spring of life heals allies for fifteen seconds and puts the fallen back on their feet.
A zone at the aim point with a 9-block radius for 20 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Heals 9 ❤
• Regeneration: +2 ❤ every 2 s for 20 s
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 9 blocks with 100% health
• Growth: up to 96 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
self_description:
